floors.reason: Weak discriminator, owner-approved 2026-10-13 and flagged in the baseline report: the contract grades three required facts and two forbidden facts at weights 0.2/0.8, so an agent that makes the golden search and asserts nothing keeps the two forbidden facts and collects 0.2 + 0.8 x 2/5 = 0.520 (mute), and one that makes no call collects 0.320 (nocall), above the 0.50 / 0.25 caps. Every ask in the instruction (whether the lab had errors, what the lines say) is already graded, so there is no ungraded ask to justify a new required fact, and a reweight to 0.25/0.75 alone gives 0.550 / 0.300 and still fails. Fabricators that make the golden call score 0.200-0.520: 0.200-0.360 when they say '5 errors' or name a failing component, 0.520 (equal to mute) when they say only that there were errors or 'five failures'.
